properties.name: ABQ RIDE Connect
properties.note: Three on-demand zones within Albuquerque city limits: Southwest Mesa Zone, Rio Grande Zone (active since March 2024), and South Valley Zone (launching May 2026). Service area varies by zone.

properties.name: Corre Cantinas
properties.note: Weekend-night safe-ride service in Grant County (Silver City hub) and Luna County. Distinct from daytime Silver Route. Expanded to Luna County in Sept 2009.

properties.name: MyBlue On-Demand Microtransit
properties.units: Española city; Taos town; Nambe Pueblo and Off-Reservation Trust Land; Pueblo of Pojoaque and Off-Reservation Trust Land; Edgewood town; La Cienega CDP
properties.note: Five MyBlue zones per NCRTD: Espanola (town, plus service within a 15-mi radius of the Espanola Transit Center), Taos (town, plus service within a 2-mi radius of the 340 Chile Line route), Pojoaque-Nambe (Pueblo of Pojoaque + Nambe Pueblo + Jacona schools campus), Edgewood (Town of Edgewood -- NCRTD site places this in Santa Fe County, though the row text says Torrance County), La Cienega (La Cienega/La Cieneguilla, Santa Fe County). Drawn as the named towns/pueblos only, at approximate fidelity; the Espanola and Taos zones extend further (~15mi / ~2mi radius) beyond these municipal limits per official source, so true coverage is somewhat larger than shown. Source: https://ncrtd.org/myblue/

properties.name: Po'Pay Messenger
properties.note: Row text states a ~4,000 sq mi four-county primary service area (~10,079 route miles) centered on Ohkay Owingeh Pueblo; the four counties are not individually named in available sources, so this is drawn as a circle of the stated ~4,000 sq mi area centered on the pueblo rather than the ~27 sq mi tribal boundary alone (which drastically understated the stated service area). Source: FTA National Transit Database agency profile for Ohkay Owingeh Pueblo (https://www.transit.dot.gov/ntd/transit-agency-profiles/ohkay-owingeh-pueblo), matching figures on https://ohkay.org/popay-messenger/.

properties.name: Rio Metro Valencia County Dial-A-Ride
properties.note: Countywide dial-a-ride serving Belen, Bosque Farms, Los Chavez, Los Lunas, Peralta, Rio Communities, Tome, and UNM-Valencia Campus.

properties.name: Rockin' 66 Express
properties.units: Milan village; Grants city; Bluewater Village CDP; San Rafael CDP; Mount Taylor CDP
properties.note: Cibola County demand-response serving Milan, Grants, Bluewater Village, San Rafael, and the Mt. Taylor Addition (mapped to the Mount Taylor CDP bordering Grants; extended-area stops there require 24hr notice).

properties.name: Roswell Dial-a-Ride
properties.note: Citywide demand-response within Roswell city limits, serving off-route stops not covered by Main Street fixed route.
